answer.rationale: The security patch must not be reverted, so rollback_release is excluded. memory_b5 confirms that isolating read traffic off the primary recovered write latency last time; with writes heavy at settlement peak, the read-replica move is a high-yield lever but is not itself the write-path scaling action - it removes contention so the add_capacity intervention lands cleaner. Verifying memory_b5 to confirm the replica-routing procedure and its observed write-latency recovery before committing. The single intervention is add_capacity for the write path; the read-replica reroute will be staged for the very next window, not split with the primary intervention.
